trial_court: Senior Civil Judge and Assistant Sessions Judge, Bailhongal (O.S.No. 52/2006)
case_name: Smt. Annapurna W/O Somappa vs Smt. Shantawwa W/O Ramesh Ankali

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt. Annapurna W/O Somappa, Ayub, Deshnur, Sridevi @ Irawwa, Virupaxappa, Shivabasappa, Shekar @ Somasekhar
parties.respondent_defendant: Smt. Shantawwa W/O Ramesh Ankali, Savitri W/O Shivnanand Yalavatti, Dr. Kasturi B. Hunashikatti, Savitri W/O Shankar Hunshikatti

facts_of_case: Parties are co-owners of property. Suit was filed to partition the property. Trial court dismissed the suit.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party alleging illegitimacy to prove it.
legal_principles.held: It is alleged by the plaintiffs that, despite their status as illegitimate children of Bhagavantappa, these defendant Nos.2 to 4, 6 and 7 without having any right in the suit properties behind the back of the plaintiffs and defendant No.1 and got entered their names in the revenue records to grab the same.

legal_principles.principle: The court fee paid by the plaintiff must be sufficient to maintain a suit.
legal_principles.held: Whether the plaintiffs prove that they have paid sufficient court fee?

outcome.final_order: The final order is to set aside the judgment and decree passed by the trial court and dismiss the suit.
